anomalies.observed: R4 is connected between DISP_RES and VCC with a value of 10 Ω. The SPICE deck also models it as 10 Ω.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that R4 is a 10 kΩ pull-up on the active-low OLED reset line DISP_RES.

evidence.quote: DISP_RES: U2 pin 33 (PB12) — R4 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U4 pin 14 (RES#)

anomalies.impact: A 10 Ω pull-up on the active-low display reset line is far too strong. If the MCU drives PB12 low to reset the OLED, it would attempt to sink roughly 330 mA at 3.3 V, exceeding GPIO drive capability and potentially damaging the MCU or preventing a valid reset. The display reset behavior would deviate from the intended design.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is detected: R4 is implemented as a 10 Ω pull-up on DISP_RES instead of the specified 10 kΩ reset pull-up, creating a potentially damaging low-impedance path to VCC when the MCU asserts reset.
